cases.expected: No exception thrown; preloadJsonSchemas is called with null argument (should handle gracefully)
cases.description: When the PrefixItemsValidator is constructed with a null tupleSchema, calling preloadJsonSchema() must not throw NullPointerException and must delegate the null list to preloadJsonSchemas.

cases.expected: No exception thrown; preloadJsonSchemas is called exactly once with an empty list
cases.description: Validate that an empty tupleSchema results in a single call to preloadJsonSchemas passing an empty collection, ensuring the method correctly handles the empty case.

group: Preload with tupleSchema containing null element

cases.expected: No exception thrown; preloadJsonSchemas is called with a list that includes a null entry
cases.description: Ensure that the method tolerates a null element inside tupleSchema and still forwards the list to preloadJsonSchemas without throwing.

cases.expected: No exception thrown; preloadJsonSchemas is called exactly once with a list containing the single JsonSchema instance, preserving its reference
cases.description: When PrefixItemsValidator is constructed with a tupleSchema list that holds one JsonSchema, calling preloadJsonSchema() must forward that list to preloadJsonSchemas without alteration.

group: Preload propagates exception from schema preload

cases.description: If any JsonSchema in tupleSchema causes preloadJsonSchemas to throw a RuntimeException, preloadJsonSchema() must not swallow it; the exception should bubble up.

cases.expected: No exception thrown; preloadJsonSchemas is called once with the unmodifiable list instance
cases.description: When tupleSchema is created via Collections.unmodifiableList(...), preloadJsonSchema() should still be able to pass the list to preloadJsonSchemas without attempting to modify it.

cases.expected: No exception thrown; preloadJsonSchemas receives the list in the same order as defined in tupleSchema (e.g., schemaA, schemaB, schemaC)
cases.description: Ensures that preloadJsonSchema() does not reorder the tupleSchema elements before delegating to preloadJsonSchemas, which is important for positional validation semantics.

group: Preload with list that throws UnsupportedOperationException on modification

cases.expected: UnsupportedOperationException thrown from preloadJsonSchema() and propagated to the caller
cases.description: Provide a tupleSchema implemented as a custom List that throws UnsupportedOperationException when a mutating method (e.g., add) is called. If preloadJsonSchemas attempts to modify the list, the exception should bubble up.
